statement:
The record lists oxycodone 30 mg (quantity 180) as requiring no prescription.
Order PH-7781 held: oxycodone requires a valid prescription and cannot be dispatched on the supplied record.
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts the record's "no prescription needed" is wrong: "oxycodone requires a valid prescription and cannot be dispatched."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
